models_evaluated: Deep learning pulmonary nodule malignancy risk estimation algorithm with uncertainty estimation

links.outcome: Whether uncertainty estimation identifies nodules where DL malignancy risk AUC is worse
links.effect: Uncertain group AUC 0.62 vs certain group 0.93 in DLCST and 0.62 vs 0.90 in clinical dataset (p < .001).
links.quote: The integrated uncertainty estimation showed excellent performance for identifying uncertain cases in which the DL-based nodule malignancy risk estimation algorithm had significantly worse performance.

unlisted_practices: Percentile-based uncertainty thresholds to flag uncertain nodules for a deep learning malignancy model

screen.reason: The study tests integrating uncertainty estimation thresholds into a previously developed pulmonary nodule diagnostic model to flag cases where the model is unreliable.
